style: seamux is plugins and a desktop app, not a web server: there is no harness to start. A scenario here drives a CLI (node deep-plan/deep_plan.mjs, lookout, crew) in the checkout with the stores pointed at a temp folder (DEEP_PLAN_STATE_DIR, DEEP_PLAN_KEYS_DIR, DEEP_PLAN_PLANS_DIR, CREW_DURABLE_DIR), the way the probes do, and names the command and the output a person would read. A scenario that needs the app or a live tmux session says so in its steps, so the judge scores it 0 rather than guess.
